# orders-service runbook

## Logs

When a column is missing, the quickest fix is `make db-reset`, which recreates the database from fixtures. Service logs are in journald. Use `make logs` for the last deploy and `journalctl -u orders` for the service. Logs are kept for 14 days.

## Migrations

Migrations live in migrations/versions and run with `make migrate`. The deploy job runs them unless DEPLOY_SKIP_MIGRATIONS is set.

## Integration tests

Integration tests run against the staging database after every deploy. Staging is shared with the QA team, who keep their manual test accounts and orders there. Results go to #orders-alerts.

## Rollbacks

To roll back, redeploy the previous tag from CI. Database migrations are not rolled back automatically; write a new migration instead.
